cards.text: The LORD is speaking through Hosea, His prophet, and so far it's been rough. He's been describing His people as an unfaithful wife who went after her lovers and burned incense to the Baals, and He just said, "But Me she forgot" (Hosea 2:2-13). Then He says, "Therefore, behold." Friend, I'm bracing myself.

cards.question: After all that hard talk about His unfaithful people, the LORD says, "Therefore, behold." What does He say He'll do with her?

answers.text: Allure her and speak to her tenderly
Leave her to wander on her own
Hand her back over to her lovers

cards.text: After ALL that, the LORD says He'll lead her to the wilderness and speak to her TENDERLY. Friend, the most tender words I ever heard in the junk drawer came from the dead batteries I shared it with, and those words were "Scoot over."

cards.question: Earlier, the LORD said He'd destroy her vines (Hosea 2:12). Now, in the wilderness, He says, "There I will give back her ___."

cards.text: Then the LORD names a place: the Valley of Achor, where Achan, the man who brought trouble on Israel, was stoned (Joshua 7:24-26). Not exactly the kind of place you put on a postcard.

cards.question: The LORD says He'll take the Valley of Achor, that place tied to trouble, and make it into a gateway of ___.
True or false: The LORD says that in the wilderness, His people will respond as they did in the day they came up out of Egypt.

cards.text: Then the LORD declares what's coming "in that day." She's going to call Him by a different name.

cards.question: True or false: In that day, she will call the LORD "my Master" and no longer call Him "my Husband."
The LORD says He'll remove something from her lips, so it's never invoked again. What is it?

answers.text: The songs of her old feasts

cards.text: Now the LORD says that on that day, He'll make a covenant for them. And wait till you hear who's on the other side of it.

cards.question: On that day, who does the LORD say He'll make a covenant with for His people?

answers.text: The beasts and birds and crawling creatures
The kings of the nations around them
The priests who served the Baals

cards.text: Even the creatures that crawl on the ground get included! Friend, there's a spider in the corner of my bakery, and every morning somebody screams, and it is NOT the spider.

cards.question: Then the LORD talks about the land itself. What does He say He'll abolish there?
True or false: Along with abolishing battle in the land, the LORD says He'll make His people lie down in safety.

cards.text: Then the LORD speaks right to her: "So I will betroth you to Me…" Friend, after everything we heard about her lovers and the Baals, I did NOT see that coming.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says He'll betroth His people to Himself for a season.

cards.text: FOREVER. And He says He'll betroth her in righteousness and justice, in loving devotion and compassion, and in faithfulness. Friend, I had to sit down for that one, and I don't even have knees.

cards.question: The LORD says this forever betrothal leads somewhere. What does He tell her she'll do?

cards.text: Then the LORD says that on that day, He will respond. He responds to the heavens, and the heavens respond to the earth.

cards.question: The chain of responses keeps going: "And the earth will respond to the ___, to the new wine and oil."

cards.text: Then the grain, new wine and oil respond to Jezreel, the name the LORD gave Hosea's first son (Hosea 1:3-4). Friend, that is a phone tree that actually WORKS.
Then the LORD says He'll sow her as His own in the land. And remember Hosea's daughter and son, whose names mean No Compassion and Not My People (Hosea 1:6-9)?

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says He will have compassion on "No Compassion."
What does the LORD say He'll tell the people called "Not My People"?

answers.text: You may live near My people

cards.question: When the LORD calls the ones named "Not My People" His people, how do they answer Him?

findings.problem: Stop 1, card 4 quotes "There I will give back her ___.", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

findings.problem: The opening card has 4 sentences: "The LORD is speaking through Hosea...", "He's been describing...", "Then He says, 'Therefore, behold.'" and "Friend, I'm bracing myself."

rule.text: The opening card can be up to 3 sentences. It says who is speaking, to whom, and what is going on. If the passage starts in the middle of a thought, it gives the context.

findings.problem: This story card has 3 sentences ("FOREVER.", "And He says He'll betroth her in righteousness...", "Friend, I had to sit down...") and carries three beats: forever, the five qualities of the betrothal, and the joke.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The question says the forever betrothal "leads somewhere," which presents knowing the LORD as a result of the betrothal. Hosea 2:20 only joins the two with "and" ("And I will betroth you in faithfulness, and you will know the LORD"). It does not say how they connect.

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

findings.problem: The wrong answer "Never see trouble again" is close to what the passage promises in Hosea 2:18 ("abolish bow and sword and battle... make them lie down in safety") and in 2:15 (trouble's valley made a gateway of hope). A baker could argue it is right.

rule.text: Each wrong answer must be false anywhere in the passage, not just at that moment. No near-matches. A wrong answer never means the same as the right answer, or close to it. If a baker could argue it's right, replace it.

findings.problem: The question uses "No Compassion" without saying it is a name, or whose name it is. That context only appears on the story card before it, which is no longer on screen.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what.
